'''Volume 9''' is the ninth and final volume published {{pkmn|in France}} by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Black & White}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Major events==
* [[N's Castle]] appears from beneath the {{un|Pokémon League}}, and [[Team Plasma]] appears.
* {{adv|Black}} and {{p|Reshiram}} face [[N]] and {{p|Zekrom}}.
* The Gym Leaders are freed.
* {{adv|White}} meets [[Anthea and Concordia]], who tell her about N and his past.
* Black defeats N.
* Black battles with [[Ghetsis]] and defeats him.
* N sees the error of his ways and bids farewell.
* Black is thrown onto Reshiram as it is reverting back into the [[Light Stone]], and subsequently disappears.
* Several {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s escape and go into hiding.
* {{adv|Whitley|One}} of the Grunts receives a [[Foongy|Foongus]] from Anthea and Concordia that was liberated by N, and a locket containing N's photograph.

===Additions===

==Trivia==
* This volume, while using the same cover illustration as [[Pokémon Adventures volume 50]], extends into the dust jacket showing an additional illustration of {{Adv|Black}} and his Pokémon, which was used on {{PAV|51}}.
